benign.note: CIC class Benign. This is the dataset's benign label, not a MITRE tactic.

ftp-bruteforce.note: Proxy only. CIC name for FTP password guessing against an exposed service. The CSV does not assign a MITRE tactic. initial_access is the closest of the six PREDICT-X stages; credential access is not one of those stages.

ssh-bruteforce.note: Proxy only. CIC name for SSH password guessing. Same limitation as FTP-BruteForce.

infilteration.note: Proxy only. The files spell this class Infilteration. On 2018-02-28 and 2018-03-01 that one label covers the infiltration scenario and does not separate foothold, discovery, command-and-control, or exfiltration. lateral_movement is the closest single PREDICT-X stage for post-compromise internal activity, not a per-flow MITRE annotation.

bot.note: Proxy only. CIC name for the Friday botnet scenario. The CSV does not assign a MITRE tactic. command_and_control is the closest of the six PREDICT-X stages for an established bot talking to its controller, not a per-flow MITRE annotation.

brute force -web.note: Proxy only. CIC name for HTTP password guessing, including the 2018-02-22 and 2018-02-23 web-attack captures. The CSV does not assign a MITRE tactic. initial_access is the closest of the six PREDICT-X stages; credential access is not one of those stages.

brute force -xss.note: Proxy only. CIC name for cross-site scripting against a web application. The CSV does not assign a MITRE tactic. initial_access is the closest of the six PREDICT-X stages for an exploit aimed at the exposed application, not a per-flow MITRE annotation.

sql injection.note: Proxy only. CIC name for SQL injection against a web application. The CSV does not assign a MITRE tactic. initial_access is the closest of the six PREDICT-X stages for an application exploit, not a per-flow MITRE annotation.

stage_mapping_disclaimer: CIC-IDS-2018 Label values are attack-class names. They are not MITRE ATT&CK tactics and they are not PREDICT-X stages. The mapping above is an explicit proxy.
window_label_rule: A window is labeled with its most frequent non-benign CIC label when any attack flow is present; otherwise Benign.

unavailable_features.reason: Omitted from CIC_FEATURES. These CICFlowMeter ML CSVs have no source-IP column.
Omitted from CIC_FEATURES. These CICFlowMeter ML CSVs have no destination-IP column.

split.method: future session holdout inside each capture day
split.rule: Windows are 60s. Within each day, a gap longer than 120s starts a new session. The earliest session is train. Later sessions are test. Horizon pairs stay inside one session, so a training window never predicts a test label. The logistic regression, horizons, scaler, and metrics are baseline.train.
